light_description: South Korean boutique overdrive from A3 Stompbox, documented by the builder as its first overdrive after years of field testing and development, voiced around a JCM800-type response.
Current South Korean boutique overdrive in the A3 Stompbox catalog, retained as a named product distinct from ANGEL.

Current South Korean boutique distortion from A3 Stompbox; the builder's own shop lists it as a core gain product, while secondary documentation identifies the Groovim family as a fully analog hand-wired design.
South Korean Groovim variant with an added 808-style midrange focus and tighter response, documented as a distinct product state.
Current A3 Stompbox bass-oriented overdrive listed in Korean dealer catalogs alongside the standard AWESOME overdrive.

Hong Kong modular analog overdrive offered both as an assembled pedal and as a plug-and-play DIY kit; retained as a research candidate because the builder's primary mission centers on pedal education and self-build systems.
Hong Kong modular fuzz offered both as an assembled pedal and DIY kit, using switchable diode-clipping states; retained as a research candidate under the MED modular platform.
